title: Poster flicker montage loop
summary: About 28 full-bleed vertical posters hard-cut every 2 to 14 frames (4 cuts per second), with 2 to 3 frame interstitial frames, slice glitches and a white flash as accents; it ends on the opening poster so it loops.
use_when: A studio or designer showreel built from finished poster or cover work
A launch-day vertical teaser where volume of work is the message
A seamless loop for a social profile, story or event screen
A silent autoplay feed where no copy needs to be read

structure.motion: hold 9 fr (f3-12); first 3 fr after the cut are an interstitial frame (±0.25 s)

structure.motion: hold 12 fr (f12-24); white full-frame flash at f18 for 3 fr

params.posters: ordered list of about 28 vertical stills (9:16, cover-cropped), the first repeated as the last for the loop
params.interstitials: cut indices that open with a 2-3 fr foreign poster frame (default cuts at f3, f27, f36, f42, f54, f69, f75, f96, f173)
params.glitchAt: frames that get SliceGlitch bands (default f24-27 graphic and f39-42)
params.fps: composition fps (default 30); hold lists scale with it

notes: Measured: 25 hard cuts in 6.17 s (4.05 cuts/s), holds 2-14 fr, median about 6 fr; no camera move (motion.json zoom under 0.3 %/s). Nine cuts carry a 2-3 fr interstitial frame of another poster (cuts.json via flash). Silent reference: sfx planned by the glue rule, not measured. Proposed term (recipe.md only): interstitial-frame cut. Loop: frame 185 equals frame 0.
